newsitem.title: USA: Supergen to buy Israel Chem interest.
newsitem.headline: Supergen to buy Israel Chem interest.

text.p: SuperGen Inc said on Thursday it agreed to buy one third of Israel Chemicals Ltd's interest in SuperGen for $8 million.

Under the terms of the agreement, Israel Chemicals relinquishes all of its international marketing rights to SuperGen products and releases SuperGen from all residual obligations remaining from Israel Chemical's investment in the company, SuperGen said in a statement.

SuperGen said the companies also have agreed to an option for SuperGen to purchase back about half of Israel Chemical's remaining stake at a price expected to be below the market price following a call of SuperGen's warrants.
The warrants will raise an additional $36 million if they are fully exercised, Supergen said.
The option is exercisable by SuperGen or Israel Chemical for a period of 90 days following the warrant call.

In addition, Israel Chemcial has agreed to a six-month lock-up on its remaining shares of SuperGen common stock. SuperGen said self-managed financing efforts may be used to fund the ICL share repurchase, as well as to provide further funding for ongoing operational and development costs.
